source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot to BIOS setup menu
    2. Check the value of BIOS Vendor in Main page

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Value of BIOS Vendor should be shown correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 0 2>&1 | grep -i 'Vendor' | head -1 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL return the BIOS Vendor line from `dmidecode -t 0` (this is the value the BIOS setup Main page shows). No RISK.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; dmidecode is a useful cross-check but does not prove the Main-page rendering.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / CHANGED; preserves the UI observation and treats OS/BMC inventory as supporting evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: No additional exact-code technical record found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that the BIOS Vendor value rendered on the BIOS Setup Main page matches the approved vendor string for the exact board and BIOS build.
original_method: Enter BIOS Setup, open the Main page, capture the Vendor field and compare it to the owner-provided expected string; optionally cross-check SMBIOS Type 0, exit safely and verify normal boot.
manual_activity: A human must enter the pre-OS UI and visually confirm the Main-page field and page context; dmidecode cannot show what was rendered.
safety_requirements: Drain workloads before the boot interruption.
Do not change or save BIOS settings.
agent_execution_scope: Run/prepare the read-only dmidecode Type 0 cross-check when execution is later approved.
Compare supplied UI and inventory evidence against the expected string.
Report differences without claiming UI observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply the expected string and approve the boot window.
Observe/capture the BIOS Main-page Vendor field.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially applicable as a read-only SMBIOS cross-check, but not equivalent to the source-required BIOS Main-page observation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the dmidecode command as supporting evidence and retain UI capture as the acceptance method.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: dmidecode -t 0 command, Main-page Vendor check and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the Main page with board/build context and compare its exact string with the approved reference and unfiltered `dmidecode -t 0` record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a read-only independent inventory cross-check without replacing UI evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS may match while UI presentation is wrong or unreadable.

project_override_considerations: A project may define exact or normalized string comparison, but must document that rule and still preserve the Main-page visual check.
expected_evidence: Safe exit and normal boot/log health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires a Main-page vendor check. Missing expected text is readiness; the DeepSeek substitution is a prior-review coverage error.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear and manual; expected string, console and window are inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reclassifies its command-only YES because SMBIOS cannot prove UI rendering.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on MANUAL ONLY and supporting inventory role.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent cross-check capability, UI execution and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Preserves a useful command without allowing it to reduce coverage from UI rendering to firmware inventory only.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source names a specific BIOS UI page and visible field. Because human observation of that page is the acceptance core, the case is MANUAL ONLY even though the underlying vendor datum is also machine-readable.
no_automatic_retry: Do not reboot back into Setup automatically after a mismatch or abnormal exit; preserve UI/inventory evidence and stop.
